shared_elements: figures shown in low relief on a rectangular slab
carved sign or ornamental filler in upper field
justification: Both depict human figures in profile with raised arms and long garments carved in low relief on a slab, a broadly generic correspondence. A shows a single large winged bearded figure with elaborate feathered wings, horned headgear and stylised plant rosettes filling the field, while B shows several small, thinly incised figures in a row with a band of sign-like glyphs above; the distinctive winged figure and plant motifs of A have no counterpart in B, and the multi-figure register with inscription in B none in A.
